description: R08 Host ScreenBuffer hyperlink checkpoint: safe Rust owns URI/custom-id hyperlink-map identity and lookup semantics.

entries.notes: Safe Rust allocates independent hyperlink ids and preserves URI lookup for hyperlinks without a custom id.
The same custom-id/URI pair resolves to a stable hyperlink id while a different custom id remains independently addressable.
A reused custom id does not alias distinct URIs; each custom-id/URI pair receives its own stable hyperlink id.
